assets.name: terrain
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: terrain texture atlas for a polished strategy board game.
Primary request: Generate exactly one 1536 by 1024 pixel landscape image as a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, no gutters, six equally sized 512 by 512 pixel SQUARE cells filling the entire canvas. Sharp cell changes at x=512, x=1024, and y=512.
Cell order left to right then top to bottom: TOP LEFT: lush dark emerald conifer forest, believable layered pine canopies, small woodland clearings and timber terrain. TOP MIDDLE: vivid rust-orange clay hills and modest clay quarry terraces, warm tactile earthen terrain. TOP RIGHT: fresh vibrant lime-green pasture with several small recognizable woolly white sheep and believable grass. BOTTOM LEFT: golden cultivated hay fields with broad field bands and a few golden hay sheaves, agricultural terrain. BOTTOM MIDDLE: cool slate-blue rocky mountain ridges with tangible stone, crags and small alpine slopes. BOTTOM RIGHT: pale ochre sandy desert with sculpted dunes and sparse small rock outcrops.
Style/medium: Medium-detail polished hand-painted 3D miniature strategy-game terrain. Semi-realistic, vibrant, tactile grass, soil, foliage and stone. Elevated near-top-down orthographic camera. Coherent warm directional daylight, believable consistent miniature scale, strong distinct palettes and readable terrain silhouettes. Rich organic surfaces without overwhelming micro-detail. Designed to be beautiful and immediately recognizable in a small game tile.
Composition: Each terrain cell completely fills its square with its terrain. Distribute interest around the central area where a round number token will later cover the exact center. Avoid one huge central object. Readable when cropped into a roughly 100-pixel hex. All six cells share perspective, light direction and quality.
Constraints: NO flat vector icons. NO hugely simplified chunky toy shapes. NO hyper-busy tiny detail. NO coastline, water, hex outlines, borders, gutters, labels, numbers, tokens, text, UI or watermarks. NO printed words. Exactly 3 columns and 2 rows of square terrain artwork with no spacing.

assets.name: environment
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: environment MATERIAL texture atlas for a polished semi-realistic strategy board game.
Primary request: Generate exactly one 1024 by 1024 pixel square image as a precise 2-column by 2-row grid with no gutters. Four equally sized 512 by 512 pixel SQUARE material swatches fill the complete canvas edge to edge. Sharp swatch transitions at x=512 and y=512.
Cell order left to right then top to bottom: TOP LEFT: deep vibrant teal-blue ocean material, fine natural small wave texture, restrained subtle sun glints, rich saturated open-ocean water. TOP RIGHT: shallow turquoise coastal-water material with soft natural ripples and sparse white sea foam, luminous clear turquoise, entirely water. BOTTOM LEFT: sandy island ground material with fine tactile golden sand texture, scattered tiny rounded stones and sparse moss or grass flecks, entirely a top-down ground swatch with no horizon or scenery. BOTTOM RIGHT: rich dark walnut tabletop material with elegant subtle wood grain, dark warm brown, entirely flat top-down wood surface.
Style/medium: polished semi-realistic hand-painted 3D game-art materials, medium detail, natural and tactile, consistent warm soft daylight. These are seamless-looking repeatable material swatches within each square, distributed texture without one main object or vignette. Near-top-down orthographic surface view.
Constraints: NO landscapes, horizon, islands, shoreline shapes, coast outlines, symbols, objects, labels, text, UI, numbers, borders, gutters, watermarks or illustrations of tiles. Each square is only its specified material filling the full square. Maintain distinct deep ocean, shallow turquoise, golden sand, and dark walnut palettes.

assets.name: sprites
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TRANSPARENT game sprite atlas for a polished semi-realistic miniature strategy board game.
Primary request: Generate exactly one 2048 by 1024 pixel landscape PNG with a genuinely transparent background and real alpha. Arrange exactly eight separate game-object sprites in a precise 4-column by 2-row grid of invisible 512 by 512 pixel SQUARE cells. Place exactly one distinct complete isolated sprite in each cell, centered with substantial transparent padding around all sides. Every sprite entirely inside its own square, no sprite touching another.
Row-major cell order, left to right across TOP ROW: 1 a recognizable stack of rich brown timber logs with visible cut ends and bark; 2 a pile of vivid orange clay chunks with earthy texture; 3 one recognizable woolly white sheep with dark face and legs; 4 a tied golden hay sheaf with a simple rope binding.
Row-major cell order, left to right across BOTTOM ROW: 5 a cluster of cool blue-gray rocks with faceted tactile stone; 6 a wooden crate holding a visible mix of timber, orange clay, golden hay and gray rock, representing a generic resource port; 7 an ACTUAL TOP-DOWN T-SHAPED WOODEN PIER with textured planked walkway, supporting pilings, two railings, and a broader T platform at the seaward TOP, narrow landward entrance at BOTTOM. The pier is tall and narrow but fits entirely inside its square. The entire pier must be visible, viewed directly from overhead, with no water or land. 8 one small moored wooden sailboat seen directly from top down, wooden hull, mast and light cream sail, isolated with no water.
Style/medium: coherent textured semi-realistic 3D miniature game objects with medium detail, vivid and immediately readable silhouette at 32 pixels. Hand-painted polish, warm directional daylight, consistent scale. The six resource objects use an elevated near-top-down view; the actual pier and sailboat use a strict straight-down overhead view to sit on a game board. Rich tactile materials; not flat vector, not excessively simplified toys, not hyper-detailed.
Constraints: TRANSPARENT background with real alpha, never a checkerboard painted into the image. NO backdrop, no ground plane, no water, no labels, text, numbers, tiles, borders, grid lines, UI, watermarks or merged objects. Eight isolated sprites with ample transparent padding. Any small contact shadows must remain tight to the objects and fade to transparency.
